# Skymap

> Skymap draws the mapped universe in 3D at true scale, from Earth and the planets to stars, galaxies and the cosmic web. Free, no account, in a current browser.

Skymap is a free, open-source WebGPU web app. You fly the camera from Earth's surface to the edge of the observable universe in one continuous scene with no scale breaks: Earth with streamed surface imagery, the Moon, the planets and spacecraft on a live clock, the Gaia star field, the Milky Way, the galaxies, and the cosmic web between them. Catalogued stars and galaxies sit where published surveys put them, and the documentation says which parts are measured, which are derived and which are drawn.

The data comes from published catalogues, parsed at build time into a custom binary format and drawn in the browser through WGSL shaders. Galaxies: SDSS, 2MRS, GLADE and Milliquas (quasars), with DESI DR1 slices as an option. Stars: Gaia DR3 with the GCNS and Hipparcos-2 supplements. Structure: MCXC, MSCC and other VizieR cluster, supercluster, void and group catalogues; a DisPerSE filament skeleton; the MCPM slime-mould density volume; the Cosmicflows-4 density and flow fields. Each survey's citation is in ATTRIBUTIONS.md.

A guided tour, "The Long Way Out", plays the whole journey with captions. Links can open a place (`#focus=`), a moment (`#t=`), an exact camera (`#pose=`), an exhibit (`#exhibit=`) or the tour (`#tour=`).

## Live app
- [skymap.rulkens.com](https://skymap.rulkens.com/): the running app; needs a browser with WebGPU (Chrome or Edge 113+, Firefox 141+, Safari 26+)

## Source code & citation
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/rulkens/skymap): full source, MIT-licensed
- [README.md](https://github.com/rulkens/skymap/blob/main/README.md): feature list, data sources and build instructions
- [CITATION.cff](https://github.com/rulkens/skymap/blob/main/CITATION.cff): how to cite (BibTeX + APA)
- [DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20037028](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20037028): versioned Zenodo archive
- [ATTRIBUTIONS.md](https://github.com/rulkens/skymap/blob/main/ATTRIBUTIONS.md): catalogue citation requirements (each survey has its own paper to cite)
- [docs/science.md](https://github.com/rulkens/skymap/blob/main/docs/science.md): how catalogue brightness, colour and selection effects become pixels

## Use cases
- Teaching scale and large-scale structure: fly from Earth to the planets, the Milky Way and the cosmic web, with exhibits and a guided tour, without installing anything.
- Planetariums and domes: a desktop build drives fulldome projection and runs offline.
- Public outreach and curiosity: a browser-based way to see where things are in the measured universe.
- Browsing the catalogues: search by name, focus any galaxy or structure, and share the exact view as a link.
